fields.summary_ko.0: IREN (NASDAQ:IREN) fell 10% to $19.34, declining 45% over the past month, as Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, and Cantor Fitzgerald each significantly cut price targets (GS $50→$30, JPM $65→$55, CF $99→$47).
fields.summary_ko.1: Microsoft partnership capacity delays and a $6B funding gap were revealed, with Q1 net loss of $26.3B and loss per share of $0.62 (exceeding consensus of $0.49), while net debt surged from $216M to $4.43B.
